adapter_contract.age: Current child ordinal minus previous.last_checked_commit ordinal in the frozen history; every child counts, regardless of tree identity.
adapter_contract.eligibility: Only symbol_validate and positive integer K; baseline selection preserved; add periodic_audit at deadline.
adapter_contract.failure: Existing engine keeps insufficient_evidence unavailable; fatal/incomplete runs are not presented as completed trajectories.
adapter_contract.process: Each variant fresh subprocess; temporary replacement of engine.select_claims only, override module hash and rule recorded in each manifest. No public config/schema changes.
adapter_contract.reset: No mutable age counter; last_checked_commit is advanced only by engine validation result.

analysis: Descriptive fixed authored sequence; no population or speedup claim. Failed runs retained.
checks: All actual Git child blobs interpreted by the restricted stdlib oracle before execution
48 persisted child states and all last_checked/last_supported lineage
All expected selection reasons and validation verdicts
93 actual Docker probe payloads, with zero technical failures
Source snapshots and every input/output hash
Research override explicitly recorded in run manifests; production policies unchanged
hypothesis: A research selector wrapper using last_checked_commit reproduces the finite periodic-audit bound on a frozen 12-child break/restore history.

mask.selection: First allowed seed, fixed before execution; f->g edge fraction 0.5329981976520891, so the single dependency is removed.

oracle: Separate standard-library AST interpreter of the actual Git blob, supporting only zero-argument functions with one return of an integer literal or a zero-argument named call. No CAMI indexer, policy, validator or probe execution is used by the oracle.
scope: Research-only engine integration prototype, not a production policy, resume implementation, timing benchmark or main-protocol result.
